summary: Banco Santander (Brasil) S.A. filed a Form 6-K reporting the minutes of an extraordinary general meeting held June 30, 2026, where shareholders approved the merger of Esfera Fidelidade S.A. into the company. The meeting had a 95.02% voting capital quorum. The merger was approved under Brazilian law, based on an appraisal report by PricewaterhouseCoopers Auditores Independentes. The registrant is the absorbing entity in a corporate restructuring, effectively the seller of Esfera's separate identity. This is a routine internal merger, not a transformative special situation. No financial terms, premium, or board recommendation were disclosed. The filing is a foreign private issuer report of a non-US corporate action.
